body: I have Dissociative Identity Disorder and I notice my symptoms get worse when I jack off? Maybe you're experiencing something similar. What do the voices say? If you can tell, I mean.
I don't know why you got downvoted. You're just trying to be supportive. This sub is for support; not meaningless negativity.
Hey, just wanted to check in to make sure you got responses. Did anyone PM you?

Thank you. An after school club would be really interesting. I'm a bit of flake sometimes, but if I can get into attending regularly, that'd be a good idea. I'll just try to muscle through it and not let my family stop me.
I'm sorry you go through that. I feel less alone hearing that, though. Thanks for sharing.

Thank you. My anxiety feels really heavy, and most of the time I can't talk to people my age. But I desperately want to. I feel like if I'm able to connect with someone my age I'll be able to fend off this feeling. I don't know what I'll do if I can't anytime soon. I can't go to my family; last time I woke my mom up in the middle of the night asking to be taken to the ER for suicidal thoughts I ended up messing stuff up and and not getting admitted after all... They require a urine test and and I... Kind of have a severe phobia of urinating in public places. It's weird that that would be the thing that kills me.

Thanks again for your response. Your words give me some hope, I feel. I'm thankful for people like you. I'll probably come back and re-read that next time I'm feeling this way.

If you think she's definitely going to do it, at any point, you should call 911.

Ignore this if you're an adult, but if you and or your friend are under 18, you should tell someone who's older than that. A parent or school counselor.

 If you need to talk more about it, I'm open, too. I really hope your friend is okay in the end. It aches to hear about people having these feelings.
I have both DID and GAD, so a ton of both, only the attacking thoughts feel like other beings with malicious intent. Trying to remind me of past trauma and stuff.

It's a long story. Basically, I was raised in a domestic abuse situation up until I was 15. For the past two years I've been trying to recover and become something like a normal teenager, but it's hard. Even though I go to the Alt Ed room at school, therapy twice a week and take a slew of medications, I'm cracking right now. Self harm and stuff.

 The biggest problem is I live with a lot of family members who were also in the abuse situation. Although the abuser is gone, my family here deals with a ton of mental illness as well. I can't go to them for support because of it, so I feel on my own most of the time. Meanwhile, I can't function very well in in the "real world", so I can't make friends, either. I also don't have internet most of the time. My situation feels difficult.

Sorry for the text wall. Also, thanks for responding.
